summary: Independent final review found Frontend P2-C Staff Profile and Staff-Service Assignment compliant with the approved Phase 2 contract. Tenant-scoped BFF routing, server-side token handling, role-aware UI behavior, immutable membership_id, no hard-delete scope, deterministic 422 handling for malformed JSON, 404/409/422 semantics, and staff-service assignment flows were reviewed. Trusted-host gates passed: Vitest 27 files / 193 tests, TypeScript, ESLint, production build, and diff check. No unresolved findings remain.
